title: Let protection become felt, not recited
summary: Let mercy steady the breath before fear writes the day. Let this stay near the next choice: carry this with you: fear thins when shelter becomes personal again.
takeaway: Return the breath before fear chooses the story.
lifeApplication: Before the next defensive move, bring the breath back under one line of refuge and mercy.

source.shortMeaning: Fear softens when protection becomes personal and felt.
source.lifeApplication: When fear rises, make protection personal enough to steady you.
